manifest.name: dsh-easyrestart
manifest.description: Adds native "Restart" items above Quit in DSH Desktop's tray menu and Application menu.
manifest.author: jkrhug

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: dsh-easyrestart
      name: dsh-easyrestart
      config: {}

readme.text:
> 给 **DSH Desktop**（DeepSeek Harness 桌面版）的菜单加一个原生「重启」项，就在「退出」上面。
> Adds native *Restart* entries above *Quit* in DSH Desktop's tray menu and Application menu.
>
> [English](README.en.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-easyrestart)
[](LICENSE)

托盘图标右键：

```
打开 DeepSeek Harness
──────────
重启 DeepSeek Harness      ← 新增
退出 DeepSeek Harness

左上角「应用」菜单：

```
关于 DeepSeek Harness
──────────
检查更新…
管理 dsh 命令
两项都是 DSH Desktop 自己的 `Menu.buildFromTemplate()` 菜单项——字体、间距、分隔线、悬停高亮全部沿用系统原生样式，文案跟随界面语言（中文「重启」/ 英文「Restart」）。

DSH Desktop 目前没有「重启应用」的入口：关窗口往往只是隐藏到托盘，想让新装的插件生效只能从托盘「退出」再手动打开。这个项目补上这一步。

它是**插件**：装上以后可以用 `/easyrestart`、插件管理页或 agent 工具随时安装/还原，不用记命令。

> 仓库名是 `dsh-easyrestart`，插件包名仍是 `dsh-easyrestart`（沿用初版，已安装过的用户不必卸载重装）。

readme.section: 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐）
readme.text:
```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-easyrestart
```

也可以直接从 GitHub 源码安装（不必等 npm）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jkrhug/dsh-easyrestart
```

本机已有源码时，也可以按目录安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-easyrestart
```

> 用 `desktop` profile —— 本插件只在 DSH Desktop 生效，Web profile 装了不会有可见变化。

装好后 **重启 DSH Desktop**，两个菜单里就会出现「重启」项。

装好后可以随时通过以下任一方式管理：

- `/easyrestart status | install | uninstall`
- agent 工具 `dsh_easyrestart`
- 插件管理页里的「重启 dsh」一行

readme.section: 方式二：独立脚本（不走插件）
readme.text: ```powershell

readme.section: 用 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron 以 Node 模式运行
readme.text:
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = "1"
$env:ELECTRON_NO_ASAR = "1"
& "<Desktop 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" patch/apply-menu-item.mjs --check
& "<Desktop 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" patch/apply-menu-item.mjs --install
& "<Desktop 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" patch/apply-menu-item.mjs --restore
```

`--check` 看状态，`--install` 装补丁，`--restore` 还原。两种方式共用同一份实现，可以互相接力。

- **能力分类**：界面与体验
- **权限**：需要写 DSH Desktop 安装目录下的 `resources/app.asar`（权限不足会报 `EPERM`）。除此之外不写任何文件。
- **外部服务**：无。不联网、不上报、不收集任何数据。
- **平台**：Windows 桌面版（Electron）。

```
$ dsh_easyrestart status
app.asar：D:\deepseek\resources\app.asar
菜单项：已就位（应用菜单有，托盘菜单有）
```

这会让 `main.js` 变长。asar 只按 header 里每个条目的 offset/size 读取内容，所以把改好的 `main.js` **追加到 asar 文件末尾**、再把 header 里 `lib/main.js` 的 offset/size 指过去即可，其他文件位置完全不动。

**B. 「应用」菜单：等长替换。** 这个菜单项原本就在代码里，只是被 `development`（`!app.isPackaged`）条件关掉了：

| 位置 | 原来 | 改成 | 长度 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `development` 条件 | `...development ? [` | `...true        ? [` | 18 → 18 |
| 「刷新页面」项 | `role: "reload"` | `visible: false` | 14 → 14 |
两种改动都会重算并同步 header 里 `lib/main.js` 的 SHA256（`hash` 与 `blocks[0]`，等长 64 位 hex），保持 Electron 的完整性校验一致；header 文本长度不变，所以 `dataOffset` 和所有文件的绝对位置都不动。

- **DSH Desktop for Windows**（Electron）。Web 端没有这些原生菜单，装了也不会有可见变化。
- 写入需要能修改 Desktop 安装目录（`resources/app.asar`）。权限不足时会得到 `EPERM`。
- **DSH Desktop 升级会重装 `app.asar`**，补丁随之消失；升级后重跑一次 `install` 即可。锚点找不到时会明确报错，不会乱写。
- 已在 DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5`（Windows）上验证通过；`0.2.1-rc.3`（含）以前也适用。
- 只改 `lib/main.js` 的上述字节，不重打包、不动其他文件；`--restore` 是反向定位，不依赖备份。
- 每次内容长度变化都会往 asar 末尾追加一份 `main.js`（约 517 KB），反复安装/还原会让文件缓慢变大。

```
.
├─ package.json             插件清单：包名、版本、exports、cordis.patch.yml
├─ index.js                 Host 半：注册工具 dsh_easyrestart 与命令 /easyrestart
├─ lib/menu-patch.js        补丁核心：定位 asar、判状态、安装、还原、同步 SHA256

**装完没反应？** 菜单在应用启动时构建，必须完全退出 Desktop 再打开（关窗口可能只是隐藏到托盘，要从托盘「退出」）。

**会不会影响自动更新？** 补丁只改 `main.js` 内容并同步它自己的 SHA256，不碰 asar 结构和其他文件。Desktop 升级会覆盖整个 `app.asar`，补丁自然失效，重装一次即可。

**为什么不能用纯插件实现？** 见上文「原理」——原生菜单没有对插件开放的注册通道。

> Adds native **Restart** entries above **Quit** in [DSH Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DeepSeek Harness for desktop).
>
> [中文](README.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-easyrestart)
[](LICENSE)

Tray icon, right click:

```
Open DeepSeek Harness
──────────
Restart DeepSeek Harness      <- new
Quit DeepSeek Harness

Application menu (top left):

```
About DeepSeek Harness
──────────
Check for Updates…
Manage dsh Command
Both are regular `Menu.buildFromTemplate()` items of DSH Desktop itself, so font, spacing, separators and hover highlight match the native menu exactly, and the label follows your UI language.

DSH Desktop has no "restart" entry: closing the window usually just hides the app to the tray, so making a freshly installed plugin take effect means quitting from the tray and starting the app again manually. This project adds that step.

It ships as a **DSH plugin**, so you can install/revert it from the plugin manager, the `/easyrestart` command, or an agent tool.
> The repository is `dsh-easyrestart` while the plugin package is still named `dsh-easyrestart` (kept from the first release so existing installs do not need to be reinstalled).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-easyrestart
```

Or straight from the GitHub source (no need to wait for npm):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jkrhug/dsh-easyrestart
```

With a local clone, install by directory instead:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-easyrestart
```

> Use the `desktop` profile — the plugin only has a visible effect in DSH Desktop; installing it into a web profile changes nothing.

**Restart DSH Desktop** afterwards, and both menus show a Restart item.

Manage it any time with `/easyrestart status | install | uninstall`, the `dsh_easyrestart` agent tool, or the plugin manager UI.
```powershell

readme.section: run with the Electron bundled with DSH Desktop, in Node mode
readme.text:
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = "1"
$env:ELECTRON_NO_ASAR = "1"
& "<Desktop install dir>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" patch/apply-menu-item.mjs --check
& "<Desktop install dir>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" patch/apply-menu-item.mjs --install
& "<Desktop install dir>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" patch/apply-menu-item.mjs --restore
```

Both options share the same implementation (`lib/menu-patch.js`) and are idempotent.

- **Category**: Interface & experience
- **Permissions**: writes `resources/app.asar` inside the DSH Desktop install directory (`EPERM` if not writable). Nothing else is written.
- **External services**: none. No network requests, no telemetry, no data collection.
- **Platform**: Windows desktop (Electron).

```
$ dsh_easyrestart status
app.asar: D:\deepseek\resources\app.asar
Menus: installed (Application menu: yes, tray menu: yes)
```

Both menus are built in the Electron **main process** with `Menu.buildFromTemplate()`. They are native OS menus, outside DSH's Cordis slot system, and neither the renderer (`window.dshDesktop`) nor the host process exposes any quit / relaunch / menu extension point. So a menu item cannot be "registered" — the plugin patches `lib/main.js` inside `resources/app.asar`.

**A. Tray menu — insert an item.** `DesktopTray.relabel()` builds "Open / separator / Quit"; the patch inserts before Quit:

| Location | Original | Patched | Length |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `development` guard | `...development ? [` | `...true        ? [` | 18 → 18 |
| "Reload page" item | `role: "reload"` | `visible: false` | 14 → 14 |

Both changes recompute and rewrite the `lib/main.js` SHA256 in the asar header (`hash` and `blocks[0]`, equal-length hex), keeping Electron's integrity data consistent. Header text length never changes, so `dataOffset` and all absolute file positions stay put.

- **DSH Desktop on Windows** (Electron). On the web build there are no native menus, so nothing is added.
- Writing requires permission on the Desktop install directory (`resources/app.asar`); otherwise you get `EPERM`.
- **A DSH Desktop upgrade reinstalls `app.asar`**, which removes the patch. Run `install` once after upgrading; if the anchors are missing it fails loudly instead of writing garbage.
- Verified on DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` (Windows); earlier builds such as `0.2.1-rc.3` work as well.
- Only the bytes above change inside `lib/main.js`; nothing is repacked, no other file is touched, and `--restore` works by reverse lookup (no backup file needed).
- Each length-changing operation appends ~517 KB of `main.js` to the asar; repeated install/restore slowly grows the file.

```
.
├─ package.json             plugin manifest: name, version, exports, cordis.patch.yml
├─ index.js                 host half: registers tool dsh_easyrestart + command /easyrestart
├─ lib/menu-patch.js        patch core: locate asar, detect state, install, revert, sync SHA256

**Nothing changed after install?** Menus are built at app start — quit DSH Desktop completely and open it again (closing the window may only hide it to the tray).

**Does it break auto-update?** The patch only rewrites `main.js` bytes and its own SHA256; asar structure and other files are untouched. A Desktop upgrade overwrites the whole `app.asar`, so the patch simply disappears — reinstall it.
**Why not a pure plugin?** See "How it works" — native menus expose no registration point to plugins.
